verdict.rationale: Hands-on community reports confirm bulk import at scale: a 7M-article corpus (needing 16GB RAM for the initial batch import), ~80M documents once batch indexing arrived, and 1M records that 'just worked' on a small instance, with indexing described as fast. Nothing in the pack documents async task tracking or how to tell when indexing completes, and one user found the default upload size limits too low. missing for 10: any evidence of async task/status tracking for indexing completion, first-party docs on bulk/batch import performance and limits.
